lead.what: Yes if Brent crude's daily settlement for 12 October 2026 is at or above $100.00 a barrel; no if that settlement is below $100.00. Xinhua via NAMPA citing London ICE Futures Exchange: Brent December delivery settled at $106.65 a barrel on 12 October 2026.

rest.what: Yes if Élections Québec posts a complete official National Assembly seat table awarding the Parti Québécois 64 or more of 127 seats by 16:00 UTC on 12 October 2026; no if that table awards 63 or fewer, or if no complete official seat table is posted by then. Élections Québec results feed marked final 8 October 2026, reported by Open Data Canada, awarded the Parti Québécois 59 of 127 seats, below 64.

lead.what: Yes if a named official source or named news outlet reports, by 16:00 UTC on 13 October 2026, that Indian Oil Corporation, Hindustan Petroleum Corporation and Bharat Petroleum Corporation met their 12 October dollar requirements through the Reserve Bank of India's special window and did not bid for those dollars in the onshore spot market; no if any of the three is reported bidding in that market for those requirements, or if no such report is posted by that deadline. The prior is 0.64.

rest.what: Yes if a named official source or named news outlet reports, by 16:00 UTC on 16 October 2026, that at least 300,000 tonnes of Russian diesel has been loaded onto tankers under the US Treasury energy-sector waiver announced on 9 October 2026; no if no such report is posted by that deadline. The prior is 0.42.

lead.what: A Shahed hit a 25-storey residential building in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district on the evening of 12 October, killing two and injuring at least nine. Glavnoe reported at least seven others injured. The outlets disagree on the injury count.

rest.what: Russia hit no Ukrainian energy targets Tuesday, the first such day since Trump's halt. Zelenskyy counted six sites and 33 injured on Monday. Names for the other four have not been published.

Samsung Electronics fell 7.7% and SK Hynix plunged 8.8% as South Korea's Kospi closed 5.46% lower at 6,035 on Tuesday. Changxin Memory Technologies said it would unveil next-generation DRAM products for servers.
